candidates.title: EStream: Fast and Memory-Efficient MoE Prefill through Expert Virtualization on Mobile NPUs
candidates.reason: Mobile NPU MoE serving with UFS-backed expert virtualization.
evidence: 2.25-27.57x pure-prefill TTFT speedup; 1.19-12.29x lower peak memory.

candidates.title: Analytical Resource Management for Fine-grained MoE Computation-Communication Overlap
candidates.reason: Launch-time SM resource management for fine-grained MoE inference overlap.
evidence: 3.22% mean oracle regret; 1.185x geometric-mean complete-model prefill speedup over COMET.

candidates.title: Measurement-Driven Diagnosis and Mitigation of Host-CPU Co-location Interference in Single-GPU LLM Serving on a Multi-GPU Server
candidates.reason: Diagnoses and mitigates host-CPU co-location interference in LLM serving.
evidence: Unprotected co-location cuts throughput 78.8%; guided protection reduces TPOT up to 4.5x.
